title: Start using search ads, display ads, online video and more | Microsoft Advertising

facts.fact: Microsoft Advertising's limited-time offer gives new U.S. customers a $500 ad credit when they spend $250.
facts.quote: Get **$500** ad credit when you spend **$250** in Microsoft Advertising.

facts.fact: The promotional offer expires on June 30, 2027.
The qualifying minimum ad spend for the $500 credit offer is $250 in advertising charges, excluding taxes.
facts.quote: spends at least $250 on advertising charges excluding taxes

facts.fact: Promotional credit not used within ninety (90) days of award expires and cannot be carried over.
facts.quote: Any portion of the credit not used within ninety (90) days of credit award will expire

facts.fact: The offer is limited to one promotional offer per new Microsoft Advertising customer, and is valid only for new customers in the United States.
facts.quote: Limit one promotional offer per new Microsoft Advertising customer.

facts.fact: Neither the qualifying ad spend nor the promotional credit is refundable, in whole or in part.
facts.quote: Neither the original advertising qualifying spend nor the promotional credit are refundable, in whole or in part.

facts.fact: Microsoft states its ad network can reach more than 1 billion people across 187 markets globally (vendor claim).
facts.quote: Reach more than 1B people across 187 markets globally

facts.fact: Microsoft says people spend over 4 hours daily across Microsoft experiences (vendor claim).
facts.quote: where they spend over **4 hours a day** working, browsing, and playing across Microsoft experiences.

facts.fact: Per comScore qSearch (Explicit Core Search, March 2026), Microsoft audiences are 51% more likely to be higher income.
facts.quote: Tap into audiences that are 51% more likely to be higher income

facts.fact: Per comScore qSearch (Explicit Core Search, March 2026), Microsoft audiences are 25% more likely to add to cart.
facts.quote: 25% more likely to add to cart\*.

facts.fact: Per GWI data, Microsoft audiences are 34% more likely to be top household earners.
facts.quote: Microsoft audiences are 34% more likely to be top household earners

facts.fact: Per GWI data, 48% of Microsoft audiences made a purchase in the last week.
facts.quote: 48% made a purchase in the last week

facts.fact: Per GWI data, Microsoft audiences engage with ads 18% more than on competing platforms.
facts.quote: Microsoft audiences engage with ads 18% more than on competing platforms

facts.fact: Per GWI data, 56% of Microsoft audiences spend 6–10 hours online every day.
